body: China Airlines flight CI840 was scheduled to depart Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport for Kaohsiung at 18:35 on October 28, operated by a Boeing 737-800 registered B-18665. While the aircraft was taxiing for departure, it encountered a large hole in the taxiway pavement; its wheels became trapped in the depression and the jet could not move, so the flight never departed. Video and photos posted by passengers on Threads show the aircraft stopped on the apron at night, with broken pavement and scattered debris beneath the fuselage near the landing gear as ground crew in high-visibility vests worked around it.

Passengers said they felt strong bumps while taxiing, and the captain announced that the aircraft had left the paved surface and would be inspected. Cabin crew later announced a controlled disembarkation: all passengers left the aircraft and were taken away by shuttle bus, and China Airlines arranged hotel accommodation in Bangkok, leaving them to stay an extra night instead of returning to Kaohsiung. The aircraft itself also remained in Bangkok overnight. Passengers posting about the incident said Kaohsiung Airport's curfew had added to their worries about the trip home before the hotel arrangement was confirmed.

As of publication, neither China Airlines nor Suvarnabhumi Airport has released an official account of why the pavement failed, whether the aircraft was damaged, or where responsibility for the incident lies. The only accounts available so far are the videos and posts published by passengers who were on board.
en.summary: China Airlines flight CI840, a Boeing 737-800 (B-18665) scheduled to fly from Bangkok to Kaohsiung on the evening of October 28, became stuck while taxiing when its wheels dropped into a large hole in the taxiway pavement at Suvarnabhumi Airport; passengers disembarked and stayed an extra night in Bangkok, according to videos and posts published by passengers.
en.title: China Airlines CI840 Boeing 737 Stuck in Taxiway Pavement Hole at Bangkok

body: 中華航空CI840班機原訂10月28日晚間18時35分自曼谷素萬那普機場飛往高雄小港機場，由波音737-800客機（註冊編號B-18665）執飛。飛機在地面滑行準備起飛時，滑行道地面出現一個大破洞，機輪卡進凹陷處、動彈不得，航班因此未能起飛。機上旅客在Threads發布的影像顯示，飛機在夜間停在停機坪上，起落架附近的鋪面破裂、碎塊散落，身穿反光背心的地勤人員在機旁處理。
旅客貼文指出，滑行期間機上眾人感受到很大的顛簸，機長廣播表示飛機已滑出鋪面、正在接受檢查。其後空服員宣布「管制離機」，全體旅客下機並搭乘接駁車離開，華航安排旅客在曼谷住宿，較原訂行程多停留一晚；涉事飛機也留在曼谷過夜。有旅客提到，高雄小港機場的宵禁一度讓他們擔心無法當晚返家，所幸華航安排了住宿。
截至發稿，華航與素萬那普機場都尚未公布破洞的成因、飛機是否受損，以及責任歸屬；目前公開的資訊僅有機上旅客發布的影像與貼文，塌陷原因仍待官方調查釐清。
zh.summary: 中華航空CI840班機原訂10月28日晚間自曼谷飛往高雄，波音737-800客機（B-18665）在素萬那普機場滑行準備起飛時，機輪卡進滑行道地面的一個大破洞、動彈不得；旅客下機後被安排在曼谷多停留一晚。以上依機上旅客發布的影像與貼文。
zh.title: 華航CI840曼谷滑行遇地面破洞 737機輪卡陷、旅客滯留一晚
